body.message:
We sincerely apologize for sending the check-out message, and we completely understand how this may have caused confusion and concern.

The message was sent only because we were trying to reach you regarding another matter, but unfortunately, our usual message did not get delivered. As an alternative way to contact you, the check-out message was sent, which we understand may have been confusing.

Please rest assured that there is no intention to cause any concern or inconvenience. Going forward, we will make sure not to send such messages unless it is genuinely urgent and we are unable to reach you through any other means.

We truly appreciate your patience, understanding, and cooperation, and we sincerely apologize once again for the confusion caused.
